summary.text: On Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, as Shadowmoor's gloom deepens, Maralen, Rhys and Ashling join forces to destroy Oona, and Maralen deals the killing blow with moonglove and becomes queen of the fae.
Oona's death collapses the artificial cycles, and the plane enters the Pendulum Year before Eirdu and Isilu restore balance.
Years later, when Oona's consciousness seems to reassert itself, Rhys strikes Maralen with moonglove as their pact demanded, but Oko reveals he staged the ordeal and cures his sister.
